claim_text: Our CCAP includes actions to reduce our operational emissions to mitigate transition risk and protect value, and to support emissions reduction across our value chains.
metric_name: CCAP publication; Worsley Alumina Scope 1 reduction; Scope 3 emissions FY25
context_text: We have published our second Climate Change Action Plan (CCAP).；Our CCAP includes actions to reduce our operational emissions ... and to support emissions reduction across our value chains.；In FY25, our conversion of two boilers from coal to gas at Worsley Alumina contributed to a 12% reduction in Worsley Alumina’s Scope 1 emissions and a 4.2% reduction in total Scope 1 emissions, both relative to FY21 levels.；In FY25, Scope 3 emissions totalled 22.7 Mt CO2-e, 58% lower than FY24 levels.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 报告明确表明已发布CCAP，并列出与运营排放和价值链排放相关的行动及若干实际进展，足以支持“CCAP includes actions”这一表述。
notes: 该主张重点在“包含行动”，非声称已全面实现减排。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company’s CCAP contains actions to (1) reduce operational emissions and (2) support emissions reductions across its value chains. The evidence substantiates that a CCAP was published (“published our second Climate Change Action Plan”) and provides a concrete example of an operational-emissions reduction action and outcome: converting two boilers from coal to gas at Worsley Alumina, contributing to a 12% reduction in Worsley Alumina Scope 1 emissions and a 4.2% reduction in total Scope 1 emissions in FY25 relative to FY21. However, the evidence does not substantively verify that the CCAP includes actions to support emissions reduction across the value chain; it only reports a Scope 3 total (22.7 Mt CO2-e) and a 58% decrease vs FY24 without linking that change to CCAP actions or describing specific value-chain actions. The transition-risk/value-protection rationale is also not evidenced beyond the stated intent.
